terms.metaDescription: The terms wey dey guide how you go use SentinelX Esports platform.
terms.s1P1: SentinelX Esports na mobile esports platform wey Samuel Chinoyerem Akpoke dey run (“we”, “us”, “our”). We dey based for Nigeria and our platform dey available for sentinelxesports.com.
terms.s1P2: If you create account or use any part of SentinelX, e mean say you don agree to dis Terms of Service. If you no agree, abeg no use di platform.
terms.s2Heading: 2. Wetin You Need Before You Fit Join
terms.s2P1: You must don reach 13 years before you fit create account. If you no reach 18, you don confam say your parent or guardian give you permission to use di platform. Players wey no reach 18 no fit withdraw prize money without say their parent or guardian confam am well well.
terms.s2P2: You fit get one account only. If you create plenty accounts to cheat, dem go permanently ban you.
terms.s3P1: Na your work to keep your login details safe. No share your password with anybody. Anything wey happen for your account, na you dey responsible for am.
terms.s3P2: If you feel say person don enter your account, contact us sharp sharp for <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>.
terms.s4P1: Every tournament get entry fee wey dem go show you clearly before you register. Right now, standard fee na ₦500. If you register and complete payment, e mean say you don confam say you wan play.
terms.s4P2: Paystack dey process entry fee safely. We no dey keep your card details.
terms.s4P3: You fit use SX Coins to reduce or waive entry fee where dem allow am. Check our Refund Policy to see how cancellation dey work.
terms.s5Intro: Every player must play straight. Dis ones no dey allowed:
terms.s5List:
• To submit fake or manipulated match result
  • To use outside tools, scripts, or exploit to get advantage
  • To gang up with your opponent to fix result
  • To threaten, harass, or abuse your opponent
terms.s5P2: You must submit match result with evidence (screenshot and screen recording). Wetin admin decide for disputed result, na im be final.
terms.s5P3: No-show — wey mean say you no show up for your match without notice — go make you forfeit and lose SX Score.
terms.s6P1: Prize money dey enter di bank account wey you link to your player dashboard through Paystack. You must complete identity verification before your first withdrawal.
terms.s6P2: We dey try process approved withdrawal within 1–5 business days. If your bank delay am, na dem cause am, no be us.
terms.s7P1: SX Coins na virtual currency wey dey inside di platform. You go earn am as you dey play and spend time for di platform. SX Coins no get any cash value and you no fit change am to money. You fit use am inside di platform for entry fee discount, community features, and di in-platform store.
terms.s8P1: Gaming Exchange (wey Zolarux escrow dey power) make players fit buy and sell gaming accounts and in-game items. SentinelX dey provide di platform and escrow infrastructure. We no be part of di transaction between buyer and seller and we no dey responsible for any dispute wey come from transaction wey happen outside di platform escrow system.
terms.s9P1: You agree to respect every other member of SentinelX community. Hate speech, discrimination, threat, and harassment no get space here — e go cause suspension or permanent ban. Check our Community Rules to see di full standards.
terms.s10P1: All SentinelX branding, design, and original content na SentinelX Esports property. You no fit copy or share our content without written permission. Content wey you post (match screenshots, community posts) still remain yours, but you dey give us licence to show am for di platform.
terms.s11P1: SentinelX Esports no dey liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential loss wey come from how you dey use di platform. Di total wey we fit owe you for any claim no go pass di total entry fee wey you don pay us for di last 3 months before di claim.
terms.s11P2: We no dey guarantee say platform go dey up 24/7. We go try our best to restore service quick quick if downtime happen.
terms.s12P1: We fit update dis Terms anytime. We go notify you through di platform or email if any major change happen. If you still dey use SentinelX after we post di changes, e mean say you don accept di new terms.
terms.s13P1: Dis Terms dey follow di law of Federal Republic of Nigeria. Any dispute go dey under Nigerian court jurisdiction.
terms.s14P1: You get question about dis Terms? Email us for <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email> or message us for WhatsApp: <whatsapp>+234 903 239 5685</whatsapp>.
